claims.text: A 13-year-old girl with moderate depression intentionally ingested about 10 clonazepam tablets and 8 lithium carbonate tablets, with weakness, limb tremors, altered consciousness, dizziness and nausea, and a Pediatric Severity Score of 2. Serum clonazepam was 165.0 μg/L at admission. Gastric lavage was done about 15 h after ingestion with activated charcoal, supportive care and flumazenil 0.2 mg; hemoperfusion for about 3.5 h followed with improved consciousness and a post-treatment level of 53.9 μg/L. She recovered and stayed 3 days.

The parents requested discharge for home observation; she recovered after 3 days.

Serum clonazepam was 162.8 μg/L at admission. Gastric lavage was done about 1.5 h after ingestion with activated charcoal, supportive care and flumazenil 0.11 mg; blood purification was deemed unnecessary. He recovered and stayed 4 days.
